notes: DUPLICATE: this person also exists as I182197730733 (Find-a-Grave-sourced), and wife Ann Pine as I182197730682. Same person — identical birth/death 16 Dec 1771 / 16 Dec 1842. Treat this record as primary; the duplicate carries the children list.

WIFE CONFIRMED AS ANN PINE: Craig's transcription of the Haddonfield MM minutes reads 'Ann Price' for the 13 Oct 1794 intention ('Albertson, John, s. Josiah, Jr.'), but the couple's son (on the duplicate record) is named 'Isaac PINE Albertson' (b. 1797) — a Quaker middle-name convention preserving the mother's maiden name. Pine is correct; Price is a transcription slip.

CHILDREN (from duplicate I182197730733): Josiah (1795), Isaac Pine (16 Dec 1797), Rachel (1800), Eleanor Rulon (1802), Ann Rogers (1805), Mary Thackara & John Jr (twins? both 27 Jul 1810), Keturah (1813), Chalkley (9 Jan 1816). CHALKLEY is the 'Chalkley Albertson' occupying the 1743 Josiah Albertson homestead in 1876 per the Magnolia borough history — the homestead stayed in this family.

OPEN QUESTION — Isaac J Albertson (I182195862458, 1824-1896), the next spine link: he is NOT in this children list (born when John was 52). Probably John's GRANDSON — via Josiah (b.1795) or Isaac Pine (b.1797) — pending the spine research. The father-son link John -> Isaac J should be treated as doubtful until resolved.

John inherited the Otter Branch plantation as a minor under his grandfather Josiah's 1783 will (his father Josiah Jr having died in 1782/3); guardianship records Aug 1783 name Isaac Tomlinson (uncle) and Isaac Ballinger.
